review_policy: Learner-facing copy is reviewed in module context for poker meaning, natural language, distractor plausibility, numerical integrity and locale parity. Deterministic checks can reject stale or invalid copy but can never create an approval.

geometry.note: LCM-01 is the manually curated bilingual gold module with stable drill and card IDs.

preflop.note: LCM-02 was rebuilt around source-backed call/3-bet/fold branch construction; exact chart cells and frequencies remain intentionally out of scope.

blinds.note: LCM-03 was rebuilt around BB price/closing action, SB squeeze exposure and source-range identity without fixed chart boundaries.

filtering.note: Original mixed-language body remains available only as the current source fallback; separate poker-aware RU and EN review is required.
